The dated5.10 continuation introduces four functors and their adjunctions. All four diagram arrows and labels are handwritten, with typed category nodes. The blank pi position in(5)b is retained. Empty tilde placeholders are attached to their actual typed letters, and cancellation x noise is replaced by unreadable-underlayer marks. The comma-like mark before in between and the heavily cancelled symbols remain doubtful.
